```{=html}
<section class="resources-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="resource-grid">
      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Model Repositories Overview</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Collection of additional model repositories including MuJoCo Golf Swing Model, Pendulum Golf Models, 
          and other biomechanical simulation frameworks. These repositories provide physics-based simulations 
          and analysis tools for understanding golf swing dynamics across different modeling platforms.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Golf Modeling Suite</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          The primary repository for golf swing biomechanical analysis. A unified platform consolidating golf swing
          modeling across multiple physics simulation frameworks including MuJoCo (recommended), Drake, Pinocchio,
          OpenSim, and MyoSuite. Enables comprehensive analysis from simple educational pendulums to complex
          290-muscle musculoskeletal models. See the <a href="models.html">Golf Modeling Suite</a> page for details
          or visit the <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/Golf_Modeling_Suite" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub repository</a>.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Pendulum Golf Models</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          Pendulum-based models and simulations that serve as simplified analogs for understanding golf swing
          dynamics. Includes single, double, and multi-link pendulum systems providing insights into control-affine
          systems, drift-input decomposition, and the fundamental physics of underactuated multibody systems.
          These models are included in the <a href="models.html">Golf Modeling Suite</a>.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Model Categories</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          The model repositories are organized by simulation platform and complexity level:
          <br><br>
          <strong>3D Models:</strong> Full three-dimensional biomechanical models (Golf Model, MuJoCo)<br>
          <strong>2D Models:</strong> Simplified planar models for educational purposes (2D Golf Model)<br>
          <strong>Physics Engines:</strong> Models using specialized physics simulation (MuJoCo, Drake)<br>
          <strong>Rigid Body Dynamics:</strong> Models using rigid body dynamics libraries (Pinocchio)<br>
          <strong>Simplified Systems:</strong> Reduced complexity models (Pendulum Models)
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="resource-card">
        <h3>Related Pages</h3>
        <p class="resource-description">
          For more information about the modeling platforms and their applications:
          <br><br>
          <a href="models.html">Golf Modeling Suite</a> - Unified platform for all physics engines<br>
          <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/Golf_Modeling_Suite" target="_blank" rel="noopener">GitHub Repository</a> - Source code and documentation
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
